acceptanceCriteria: Explicit Play configures an iPhone session that remains audible in Silent Mode and, where the operating system permits, while locked or backgrounded, without spontaneous playback or resume.

While active, applicable system media surfaces truthfully expose the selected tone, timbre, state, and an immediate Stop action; JustTones mixes with other app audio without changing the selected route or system volume.

Interruptions, route loss or format changes, and engine failures converge on a truthful non-playing or unavailable state; selected profile, pitch, timbre, and output level are preserved and Retry is offered when possible.
component: AVAudioSession category, options, activation, interruption, route-change, and media-remote integration for deliberately started iPhone playback.
componentsAffected: AVAudioSession category, options, activation, interruption, route-change, and media-remote integration for deliberately started iPhone playback.
Truthful lifecycle state, explicit recovery, duration handoff, and deterministic integration coverage.
notes: Do not add microphone access, automatic resume, route forcing, system-volume control, network services, or unapproved background behavior beyond the approved audio session capability.
rationale: Do not add microphone access, automatic resume, route forcing, system-volume control, network services, or unapproved background behavior beyond the approved audio session capability.
testSteps: Automated lifecycle and state-machine results; simulator results identified as non-physical; physical iPhone background, lock, Silent Mode, interruption, media-control, and route records retained separately.
